backend/main.py:
Page Title: chatbot.py

Module Overview:

  Purpose: This module provides functionality for a chatbot service that interacts with users through a WebSocket connection. It utilizes FastAPI for handling HTTP requests, MongoDB for storing chat session data, and OpenAI for generating responses.

  Dependencies: 
  - FastAPI: A web framework for building APIs with Python.
  - pydantic: Data validation and parsing library.
  - pymongo: Python driver for MongoDB.
  - dotenv: Library for loading environment variables from a .env file.
  - openai: Library for interacting with the OpenAI API.

Classes:

  ChatMessage:
  - Purpose: Represents a message exchanged in a chat conversation.
  - Attributes:
    - message (str): The content of the message.
    - sender (str): The sender of the message, either 'user' or 'bot'.

  ChatSession:
  - Purpose: Represents a chat session with a unique session ID, email, and a list of chat messages.
  - Attributes:
    - session_id (str): The unique identifier for the chat session.
    - email (None): The email associated with the chat session, can be None.
    - conversation (List[ChatMessage]): A list of ChatMessage objects representing the conversation.

Functions:

  health():
  - Purpose: A simple health check endpoint to verify the server is running.
  - Arguments: None
  - Returns: A dictionary with a "message" key containing "Howdy!!!".
  - Exceptions: None

  websocket_endpoint(websocket: WebSocket, session_id: str = "", email: str = None):
  - Purpose: Handles WebSocket connections for chat interactions.
  - Arguments:
    - websocket (WebSocket): The WebSocket connection object.
    - session_id (str): The unique session ID for the chat session.
    - email (str): The email associated with the chat session, can be None.
  - Returns: None
  - Exceptions:
    - WebSocketDisconnect: If the WebSocket connection is disconnected.
    - Exception: If any other error occurs during the chat interaction.

Note: The file also includes initialization of FastAPI, configuration of MongoDB connection, configuration of OpenAI, and saving chat session data to MongoDB.

frontend/src/App.css:
File Summary: styles.css

Module Overview:

  Purpose: This file contains the styling rules for the application's user interface, defining the visual appearance and layout of various components.

  Dependencies: 
  - None

CSS Rules:

  .App: 
    - Purpose: Centers the content within the application.
  
  .App-header:
    - Purpose: Styles the header of the application.
    - Attributes:
      - background-color: Sets the background color to #282c34.
      - min-height: Sets the minimum height to 60px.
      - display: Sets the display property to flex.
      - flex-direction: Sets the flex direction to row.
      - align-items: Aligns items to the center.
      - justify-content: Centers content horizontally.
      - font-size: Sets the font size to be responsive.
      - color: Sets the text color to white.

  .chat-container:
    - Purpose: Styles the chat container within the application.
    - Attributes:
      - margin: Sets the margin to 20px.
      - padding: Sets the padding to 20px.
      - border: Sets a 1px solid border with color #ddd.
      - height: Sets the height to 300px.
      - overflow-y: Enables vertical scrolling.

  .message:
    - Purpose: Styles the chat messages.
    - Attributes:
      - padding: Sets the padding to 10px.
      - margin: Sets the margin to 5px top and bottom.
      - border-radius: Sets the border radius to 10px.
      - max-width: Sets the maximum width to 60%.

  .message.user:
    - Purpose: Styles user messages.
    - Attributes:
      - background-color: Sets the background color to #dcf8c6.
      - margin-left: Aligns the message to the right.

  .message.bot:
    - Purpose: Styles bot messages.
    - Attributes:
      - background-color: Sets the background color to #f0f0f0.

  .input-form:
    - Purpose: Styles the input form for sending messages.
    - Attributes:
      - display: Sets the display property to flex.
      - justify-content: Centers content horizontally.
      - margin-top: Sets the top margin to 20px.

  .input-form input:
    - Purpose: Styles the input field.
    - Attributes:
      - width: Sets the width to 70%.
      - padding: Sets the padding to 10px.
      - border-radius: Sets the border radius to 10px.
      - border: Sets a 1px solid border with color #ddd.

  .input-form button:
    - Purpose: Styles the send button.
    - Attributes:
      - padding: Sets the padding to 10px top and bottom, 20px left and right.
      - border: Removes the border.
      - border-radius: Sets the border radius to 10px.
      - background-color: Sets the background color to #4caf50.
      - color: Sets the text color to white.
      - margin-left: Sets a left margin of 10px.
      - cursor: Sets the cursor to pointer for interaction.

Page Title: App.js

Module Overview:

  Purpose: This module represents the main component of the Elisity Chatbot application. It handles the WebSocket connection, sending and receiving messages, and rendering the chat interface.
  
  Dependencies: 
  - React: JavaScript library for building user interfaces.
  - useState: React hook for managing component state.
  - useEffect: React hook for handling side effects in functional components.
  - useRef: React hook for accessing DOM elements.

Functions:

  sendMessage(e: Event) -> void:
  - Purpose: Sends a message to the WebSocket server.
  - Arguments:
    - e (Event): The event object.
  - Returns:
    - void
  - Exceptions:
    - None

Attributes:
  - messages (array): Array of messages exchanged in the chat.
  - loading (boolean): Indicates if the chatbot is currently processing a message.
  - input (string): The user input for sending messages.
  - ws (object): Reference to the WebSocket connection.

Methods:
  - useEffect: Initializes the WebSocket connection and handles incoming messages.
  - sendMessage: Sends a message to the WebSocket server and updates the chat interface.

Overall, the App.js file is crucial for managing the chat functionality of the Elisity Chatbot application, handling message sending and receiving through a WebSocket connection.
